title: Remember the Titans
tagline: Game night in Virginia. Seconds for the whole team.
about: A newly integrated high school football team in 1971 Virginia comes together under a new coach.
cue: Serve the main after the big game.
faces: Serve the main after the big game.

    StartersGettysburg training camp hoagiesHam, salami and provolone sub with oregano vinaigrette and pickled peppersHow to make it3 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp red wine vinegar1/2 tsp dried oregano2 long baguettes150g leg ham100g salami100g provolone1/4 iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes1 red onion1 jar of pickled peppersWhisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano and pepper into a dressing.Split the baguettes and drizzle the insides with half the dressing.Layer with sliced ham, salami and provolone.Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and pickled peppers, then the rest of the dressing.Press closed and wrap tightly.Rest wrapped for 10 minutes.Cut each baguette into pieces.Titans game day chilli dogsFranks in toasted buns with beef chilli and melted cheddarHow to make it300g beef mince2 onions1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp chilli powder200g tomato passata8 frankfurts8 hot dog buns120g cheddar1 bottle of American mustardDice the onions.Brown the mince with the onion.Add the cumin, paprika, chilli powder, passata and water and simmer until thick.Grill the frankfurts.Toast the hot dog buns.Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, scatter with grated cheddar and grill to melt.Top with diced white onion and mustard.MainsCoach Boone's Virginia fried chickenButtermilk fried chicken, mashed potato, pepper gravy and chilli honeyHow to make it1.2kg chicken pieces400ml buttermilk1 bottle of hot sauce230g plain flour2 tsp paprika1 tsp garlic powder1kg potatoes90g butter500ml full cream milk3 tbsp honey1/2 tsp chilli flakes1 L vegetable oilCombine the chicken, buttermilk, salt and hot sauce in a bowl.Soak in the fridge for at least 2 hours.Toss the chicken in flour mixed with paprika, garlic powder and salt.Fry in the vegetable oil at 165°C in batches until golden and cooked through.Peel and chop the potatoes.Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.Make gravy with butter, flour, milk and lots of pepper.Warm the honey with chilli flakes to drizzle over the chicken.Sunshine's California fish tacosSunshine, the new kid from CaliforniaHow to make it600g firm white fish fillets1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin3 limes2 tbsp olive oil12 small corn tortillas300g white cabbage1 coriander2 avocados150g sour cream1 jalapeñoRub the fish with the chilli, cumin, the juice of 1 lime, the oil and a pinch of salt.Shred the cabbage and toss with the juice of 1 lime, chopped coriander and sliced jalapeño.Mix the sour cream with the zest and juice of the last lime.Cook the fish in a hot grill pan for 3 minutes a side, then break into chunks.Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and fill with fish, slaw, sliced avocado and crema.SweetsAlexandria peach cobblerCinnamon peaches under a buttermilk biscuit topping, ice creamHow to make it2 x 820g tins of sliced peaches60g brown sugar2 tsp ground cinnamon1 tbsp cornflour1 lemon80g butter200g self-raising flour3 tbsp caster sugar150ml buttermilk1 L vanilla ice creamDrain the peaches and toss with brown sugar, cinnamon, cornflour and lemon juice.Tip into a baking dish.Rub the cold butter into the flour and sugar, then stir in the buttermilk.Drop spoonfuls over the peaches and sprinkle with sugar mixed with cinnamon.Bake at 190°C until golden.Cool slightly and serve warm with ice cream.DrinksSunshine's sweet tea lemonadeSweet black tea mixed with fresh lemonade and mintHow to make it6 black tea bags160g caster sugar6 lemons1 bunch of mint1 bag of iceSteep the tea bags in boiling water with the sugar.Remove the bags and chill until cold.Squeeze the lemons and stir the sugar into the lemon juice and cold water until dissolved.Fill tall glasses with ice, pour in the tea to halfway and top with the lemonade.Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.
